events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Learning Opportunity

options.text: Let us observe their ways and traditions.
We should find out who their enemies are and make deals to undermine them.

events.text: The court is divided over the recent discovery of the [tribe]! Our scholars wish to study the [tribe] culture to deepen our understanding, but our generals insist that these savages deserve no such respect. We must make it clear to the court which way our sympathies lie.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Second Spouse

options.text: Agree to be wed to [character].
Tactfully reject the offer.
Such an offensive offer can only be met with war.

events.text: You are met by [character], along with a large warband of his best fighters. The [tribe] [title] declares that you may have peace, if you agree to take his cousin [character] as a second spouse. Your [religion] advisors are aghast at the proposal, reminding you that such an act is sinful to the religion. Will you compromise your religion for diplomacy?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: An Enemy to Fear

options.text: This threat cannot be allowed to fester.
Provoking the Huns will only lead to trouble.
Offer tribute to keep them at a distance.

events.text: The [tribe] emissaries ride through the gates of your palace with an easy confidence earned from a life spent in the saddle. You suspect that they find it just as easy to use the strange bows they carry. Standing fearlessly before you, the [tribe] describe their nomadic lifestyle and boast of the many nations that they have met, and of the many nations they have defeated. The implication is clear.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Animal Worshippers

options.text: We hold animals in high regard here.
We respect animals... as food!

events.text: The emissary from the [tribe] is accompanied by several tame beasts: A large boar, a great hound, and a nimble monkey. He explains that all life is sacred to his Tribe, and that we must respect animal rights if we wish to live in harmony with the [tribe].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Border Dispute

options.text: Purchase their goodwill with gifts of gold.
Take one of their units as a prisoner and hostage.
Convince the [tribe] leader of our peaceful intentions.

events.text: Almost immediately after discovering the [tribe] encampment, our troops are threatened by warriors at its border. Insults are traded! Weapons are drawn! Our units stand at attention, ready to act on our commands. What are your orders?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Calm Emissary

options.text: We do not wish to fight.
Tell your people to prepare for war.

events.text: A calm barbarian leader arrives in your court, poised and cautious. He says the [tribe] will not quarrel with your people if you agree to leave them alone. What is your response?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Cultural Delegation

options.text: Allow them to come tell their stories.
Hire our own local performers.
Barbarians are not welcome here.

events.text: The [tribe] would like to send a delegation of singers and storytellers to the capital. Refusing them would be an insult, but we worry that entertainers may disrupt the court. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Delighted Envoy

options.text: Yes, let our common enemy unite us.
Our people are tired of war.
We are surrounded by enemies.

events.text: [tribe] leader arrives in court. Delighted that we are already at war with his people's ancestral enemies, the [tribe], he proposes that we establish a diplomatic friendship. How shall we reply?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Disciplined Tribe

options.text: Our battle shall be epic!
Let us not quarrel.

requirements.label: Archetype Martial / Warlike / Strict
tip: The leader must have one of: Archetype Martial (a character trait); Warlike; Strict

options.text: Perhaps we can learn from their formations?

events.text: The emissary from the [tribe] was escorted to our capital by a surprisingly well-disciplined formation of soldiers who put on an elaborate show of military coordination outside the city gates. While he makes no threats, the implication is clearly that they have a powerful force at their command.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Eyes of Fate

options.text: Accept the gift, with thanks.
Reject the gift.
Send back the emissary's head.

events.text: An emissary of the [tribe] people is presented at court. They bring greetings from [character] and a small gift of intricately carved bone dice in the [tribe] manner.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Fuming Messenger

options.text: The [tribe] are not our enemies.
We will fight, but only with [tribe] assistance.

events.text: A warlord from the [tribe] stands before us, fuming. He says the [tribe] are a race of outlaws, and he demands that we make them your enemies or risk war with his people. How shall we respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Gift Exchange

options.text: Take some of our wood.
Perhaps this metal will be of use.
We will not be intimidated.

events.text: A warlord of the [tribe] presents himself at court. He says his people traditionally cement goodwill with a newly met tribe by sharing the bounty of their next hunt in exchange for a gift. How will you respond?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Gold Tribe

options.text: This is a generous gift!
Hand over your jewelry too.
We shall invest this into administration.

events.text: Adorned in golden jewelry, a delegation from the [tribe] has arrived to present us with a large gift of Money. They explain that this is an offering from their leader who hopes to establish a peaceful relationship to enrich both our peoples.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Grinning Emissary

options.text: Accept it, and feast in their honor.
Take the gift, and offer one of our own.
Our loyalty cannot be bought.

events.text: A grinning barbarian chief comes before you, bowing with respect. He explains that it is customary among the [tribe] to show their prosperity by offering gifts to new acquaintances. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Growing Tension

tip: As leader: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Tribal
As general: +25% Unit Trait Modifier / Tribal

options.text: Send soldiers to end this plot.
Earn the [tribe]' trust with a gift.
Do nothing for now but keep a watch.

events.text: Scouts have discovered [tribe] camp in the distance, and they report frequent meetings between the [tribe] and other Tribe. An alliance against our expansion may be forming. But rumors can be misleading...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Haughty Emissary

outcomes.label: Tribe Contact Haughty Emissary Peace New

options.text: We only treat with our equals.
Our blades will speak for us.

events.text: A haughty barbarian warlord strides into court, demanding an audience. He declares that the [tribe] will permit you to befriend them, but only if you recognize their superiority. How shall we respond?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Head collection

options.text: Add the emissary’s head to the collection and return it to the [tribe].
Let's not lose our heads over this!

requirements.label: Cruel / Bloodthirsty / Warlike / Fierce
tip: The leader must have one of: Cruel; Bloodthirsty; Warlike; Fierce

options.text: What a delightful way to send a message!

events.text: The emissary from the [tribe] arrives with a number of servants carrying heavy, stinking sacks. After a series of ever more elaborate threats and warnings, the servants mark the conclusion of his speech by upending their sacks and allowing a large number of severed heads in various states of decay to spill out onto the floor. “This”, he says, “is all that remains of the last city to defy us!”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Impious Leader

options.text: This can only mean war.
Overlook this slight, for now.

events.text: The first meeting with the [tribe] has not been a peaceful one. The impious [character] happened upon a convoy of [religion], who he promptly slaughtered in a cruel provocation of. The [religion] demand a response. What will you decree?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Iron Tribe

options.text: Our hearts melt with gratitude!
We, too, desire Iron.

requirements.label: Productive / Cunning / Prosperous
tip: The leader must have one of: Productive (a character trait); Cunning; Prosperous

options.text: This will make our army all the more ferocious!

events.text: A delegation from the [tribe] has arrived bearing an introductory gift of Iron. The leader of the delegation explains that the [tribe] have long gathered and mined Iron to trade with their neighbors.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Meeting the <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TRIBE_GAULS>Druids<p=SUBJECT_TRIBE_SCYTHIANS>Anarya<else>Priests<end>

options.text: Freely trade ideas with the [tribe] <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TRIBE_GAULS>Druids<p=SUBJECT_TRIBE_SCYTHIANS>Anarya<else>Priests<end>.
Demand that [character] embraces [religion].
Make war on the non-believers.

events.text: The [family] have been the first to encounter the people known as the [tribe], who have sent a delegation of their religious <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TRIBE_GAULS>Druids<p=SUBJECT_TRIBE_SCYTHIANS>Anarya<else>Priests<end> to the city of [city]. [character] has sent a as a messenger to seek your guidance. How should the [family] family deal with this delegation of the ancient gods?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Mutual Respect

options.text: We will benefit from a respectful partnership, starting with this exchange of gifts.
I would gladly take [character] as my wife to create a bond between our people.
We need the room to expand but will offer [tribe] respect in combat.

events.text: A [tribe] envoy approaches our scouting party and greets them with a respectful gesture. "Word of the great [character] has reached us before you did yourselves. Please know that my people are a proud and loyal one. We bow to no one but we return respect where it is given. Does [character] wish to live side by side with us in respect, or in combat?" The eloquence of the [tribe] is admirable - how shall you treat this curious tribe?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Mystical Tribe

options.text: Sounds insane to me.
The Spirits are wise!
The Spirits call us to dance together as one!

events.text: The [tribe] delegation commences their arrival with an exotic ritual. Chanting and dancing in a throng as pungent incense wafts around them, they claim the Spirits want our peoples to live together in peace. How should we respond?

events.author: Solver
events.name: New Contacts

options.text: Let us observe the tactics they use to protect their settlements.

outcomes.label: Tribe Contact Hanno Navigator One Goods Wood
Tribe Contact Hanno Navigator One Goods Food
Tribe Contact Hanno Navigator One Goods Stone
Tribe Contact Hanno Navigator One Goods Iron

events.text: Our explorers have made contact with the [tribe], a distant but friendly people. They are willing to exchange information with us and even gift us some of their goods in exchange for tales of our own travels. Shall we befriend the [tribe] and tell them stories of the lands that lie beyond [rival], or shall we observe from a distance?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Not Our Friend

options.text: This war is their choice.

events.text: Your meeting with the [tribe] is as short as it is unfriendly. "We see your ambition, [character]. Know that these are our lands, and [rival] is not our friend. We [tribe] were here before you and will be here after you are gone." The words of the [tribe] envoy leave little doubt as to the future of our relations.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: On the Move

options.text: Ignore them. Their presence means nothing.
We should prepare for a coming conflict.

events.text: Our scouts have identified [tribe] settlement in the nearby wilderness. Their camp appears to be temporary, and is likely part of a larger migration. The [tribe] are on the move! What is our policy toward these savages?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Once great Tribe

options.text: We are a merciful people!
We are a practical people!

events.text: An emissary from the [tribe] has arrived to establish relations with us. Glumly, he tells us that his people were once a mighty empire like us, but their land was ravaged by a disease which their King took no action to prevent until it was far too late. He hopes we will not take advantage of their current weakness.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Peaceful Emissary

options.text: I rather think that weapons are the best weapon.
I shall meet smiles with smiles.
Let us work out an agreement for the ages!

events.text: The [tribe] have sent us a charming emissary who responds to every query with a smile and a pleasant reply. "After all", he says, "in the battle for peace a smile is the best weapon".

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Refugee Outlaws

options.text: Welcome them like family.
They will stay, but they will work.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Return them to their captors.

events.text: Escaped prisoners of the [tribe] have reached [city] with a band of bounty hunters close behind. The [tribe] demand that we return these outlaws so they may face justice. How will you respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Ripe Lands

options.text: Now is the time to strike.
We must be patient.

events.text: Scouting reports portray the [tribe] lands as a valuable source of potential plunder. We should consider seizing this opportunity and taking it from them. What do you command?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Seedy Messenger

options.text: Fine, take this and go.
Begone, you wretch.

events.text: A strange man from an unknown tribe shuffles into your court. Looking everywhere but at you, he suggests that unless you are able to demonstrate your munificence, the [tribe] will take everything from you. What do you say?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Stonemason Tribe

options.text: This is no minor gift!
Destroy this querulous tribe!

events.text: The emissary of the [tribe] has arrived with a goodwill gift of Stone to show their desire for peace. He tells us that the [tribe] specialize in mining and finishing Stone, a lucrative trade. How shall we respond?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Terrifying Emissary

options.text: Perhaps tribute can buy peace?

outcomes.label: Tribe Contact Terrifying Emissary War Basic

events.text: The emissary from the [tribe] is a terrifying giant of a man. He stands over seven feet tall, and what can be seen of his skin is heavily scarred. As he growls his message to us, we can see his teeth have been sharpened to points. “Weak fools, all you will get from the [tribe] is death!”, he roars.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Tested

options.text: And I hope you enjoy a slow death. The generals shall make ready, and you and your people shall both learn respect.
Do not mistake humility for weakness, emissary.
Slowly, over agonizing moments of silence, fail to construct a retort.

events.text: A tall and imperious emissary of [character] enters the court. As she takes in the surroundings, her words are sharp. "This? This is the great [rival] we have heard of? I hope you enjoy all your stone playthings, little [title]."

events.author: Solver
events.name: The Fame of [rival]

options.text: Their best fighters are welcome to relocate.
We will allow the best [tribe] riders to settle in [rival].

events.text: Upon meeting the [tribe], our scouts are surprised to learn that stories of [rival] had reached them before our own people did. Some young men are so impressed by a meeting with real [rival] representatives that they wish to relocate to our lands and live in [rival] as citizens would. In exchange, they promise their loyalty and military service.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: The Numberless

options.text: We are wealthy and offer riches.
We are industrious and offer metal.
We are clever and offer knowledge.
We are mighty and offer war!

events.text: A chief of the [tribe] is brought to meet with you. "The Belgae, the Menapii, the Senones, the Helvetii. Our tribes are numberless, too many to name." "We are strong. What are you?"

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial: Tribe Contact

options.text: I will carefully consider my approach to Tribe like the [tribe]!

events.text: You've met your first Tribe, the [tribe]! Tribe can engage in limited diplomacy but generally won't be coordinated in the way opposing nations are. You may also find Barbarians when exploring the map. They do not behave like Tribe as you are always at War with them. Barbarians are good targets for early expansion as they are easier to drive away than a more organized Tribe. Finding some Barbarians or a weak Tribe and claiming their City Site for yourself will be an important step toward growing your nation.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: War Ambassador

options.text: We are humbled by your power.

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee

options.text: If...
You will get no such offer from us.

events.text: A gruff chieftain arrives from the [tribe]. He demands that we offer tribute or suffer a brutal, extended conflict with his people. "You are advised to submit without further delay, for if I bring my army into your land, I will destroy your farms, slay your people, and raze your city."

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Woodcutting Tribe

options.text: Tremendous!
Cut them down.
Such fine wood could really spruce up [city]!

events.text: The emissary of the [tribe] has arrived with a gift of Wood in the hopes of establishing peaceful relations with us. He explains that the [tribe] specialize in growing and harvesting wood in sustainable ways and it has led to great prosperity for them.
